name: work-mode-selection
description: Choose the SE work mode (organic / spec / receipt) from the project's declared profile (type, scale, risk, criticality, contract impact) instead of by habit. Makes the choice reproducible and auditable; read-only, never lowers a gate.

scope.description: Selecting the ceremony floor for a change from the project profile before planning or implementing it

restrictions: READ-ONLY: selects and documents the mode; does not create the SDD/RDD records itself
Never lowers a gate; it sets a floor that gates (se gate, se verify G5) can raise
NO hard-codes a personal preference as project policy; the mode must follow the declared profile

usage_rules.rule: Resolve the mode from profiles.work (type/scale/risk) + criticality + contract impact; confirm with `se ceremony --project <dir>`.
Record the profile fields that drove the mode next to the change (task/objective/RDD), so the choice is reproducible.
A contract change, high scale/risk, or critical criticality pulls the mode up to spec and/or receipt; small low-risk contract-stable changes stay organic.
